## Editorial research note

No original post or comments are available in the mapped source files. The following is retained from earlier editorial research and is not a transcription of the Reddit page:

Zehnpae reportedly praises the colorful backgrounds and the forgiving interpretation of combat gestures, while criticizing movement, pathfinding, and attempts to knock out guards that turn into unwanted sword fights. The writer reportedly abandoned careful nonlethal play after a mission counted deaths they did not cause, then found the remaining campaign less tedious.

Earlier research also records replies discussing repeated environments and alternative nonlethal tactics. A compatibility patch is mentioned, but no exact download link or configuration was preserved, so this is not a reproducible installation guide. The mission in which deaths were reportedly miscounted and the cause of that discrepancy are not identified.
